commands.kicraft.race_info.title: == %s ==
commands.kicraft.race_info.saiyan.streng: Slightly better Strength and Stamina start, Rage at low HP, stronger Zenkai, 1% Legendary Saiyan roll.
commands.kicraft.race_info.saiyan.weakne: Weak early Ki Control; later forms are intended to drain more; Legendary Saiyans risk Berserk later.
commands.kicraft.race_info.saiyan.progre: Strength and Stamina train faster, Durability slightly faster, Ki Control trains slower.
commands.kicraft.race_info.saiyan.unique: Zenkai, Rage, future tail/Oozaru path, SSJ path, LSSJ path if legendary.
commands.kicraft.race_info.half_saiyan.s: Slightly better Strength/Ki Control/Stamina start, strong growth, stronger training when hurt.
commands.kicraft.race_info.half_saiyan.w: Weaker Zenkai and Oozaru direction than full Saiyans, lower pure transformation identity.
commands.kicraft.race_info.half_saiyan.p: Most stats train faster; Ki Control and Stamina train especially well.
commands.kicraft.race_info.half_saiyan.u: Hybrid Potential, low-HP growth bursts, weaker Saiyan Rage/Zenkai.
commands.kicraft.race_info.human.strengt: Best early Focus, great Ki Control, efficient technique direction.
commands.kicraft.race_info.human.weaknes: No huge natural transformation path yet; lower raw Strength growth.
commands.kicraft.race_info.human.progres: Ki Control trains faster; Max Ki is slightly easier; Strength is slower.
commands.kicraft.race_info.human.unique: High Focus, future martial arts and Kaioken mastery direction.
commands.kicraft.race_info.namekian.stre: Slightly better Durability start, higher Max Ki, good Ki Control, passive healing, longer reach.
commands.kicraft.race_info.namekian.weak: Lower Strength growth; less aggressive form identity.
commands.kicraft.race_info.namekian.prog: Durability trains best; Max Ki and Ki Control train well; Strength trains slower.
commands.kicraft.race_info.namekian.uniq: Regeneration, Namekian reach, future giant form and Namek fusion direction.
commands.kicraft.race_info.frost_demon.s: Slightly better Strength/Max Ki start, good Ki Control, strong energy-focused direction.
commands.kicraft.race_info.frost_demon.w: Harder overall start, slower general progression, weaker Stamina growth.
commands.kicraft.race_info.frost_demon.p: Max Ki and Ki Control train well, Strength trains decently, Stamina and general growth are slower.
commands.kicraft.race_info.android.stren: Ki and Stamina stay full, stable combat, slight defensive/absorption identity.
commands.kicraft.race_info.android.weakn: No Zenkai and no natural organic transformation path; energy stats train much slower.
commands.kicraft.race_info.android.progr: Durability and Strength train better, but Stamina, Max Ki and Ki Control train much slower because energy is reactor-based.
commands.kicraft.race_info.android.uniqu: Infinite energy, energy absorption direction, future upgrades/reactor path.
commands.kicraft.race_info.bio_android.s: Good Durability/Max Ki potential, adapts from dealing and taking damage, light passive healing.
commands.kicraft.race_info.bio_android.w: Needs combat and future absorption/evolution systems to reach full identity.
commands.kicraft.race_info.bio_android.p: Most stats train slightly faster; Durability, Max Ki and Strength are favored.
commands.kicraft.race_info.bio_android.u: Adaptation, future absorption and evolution stages.
commands.kicraft.race_info.majin.strengt: Slightly better Durability and Stamina start, strong passive regeneration, tanky combat.
commands.kicraft.race_info.majin.weaknes: Lower Ki Control growth; less precise energy use.
commands.kicraft.race_info.majin.progres: Durability and Stamina train faster, Ki Control trains slower.
commands.kicraft.race_info.majin.unique: Regeneration, future absorption/body morph/candy beam direction.
